claims.claim_text: Guido Pantaleoni co-founded and practiced law at Reavis & Pantaleoni from 1935 until going to war in 1943.
claims.evidence_excerpt: In 1935, he joined an old Harvard friend, C. Frank Reavis, and started the firm Reavis & Pantaleoni.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A successor-firm publication by his son dates the firm's founding to 1935 and directly connects that chronology to his 1943 OSS service.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed identity from official NARA and DPAA identifier agreement; the institutional biography is specific to the same lawyer and OSS officer.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded as the last documented civilian employment before his 1943 wartime OSS role; no intervening affiliation is identified in the reviewed sources.
claims.match_notes: Reavis & Pantaleoni is retained as the historical employer name. White & Case is not separately claimed because the source says only that partnership was offered.
